headline: Argentina Exports Hit Record $10.06 Billion Driven by Oil and Corn Shipments
summary: Argentina's monthly exports reached $10.06 billion, exceeding full-year 2025 totals within ten months, propelled by agricultural and crude shipments, even as machinery imports contracted.
why: Agricultural exports and hydrocarbons from Vaca Muerta are Argentina's main source of foreign currency reserves to stabilize its balance of payments.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Strong petroleum and corn export inflows support trade surplus expansion and central bank reserves.
